teach.heading: Your stop loss belongs where the setup is proven wrong.
teach.body: In an uptrend, that's below the swing low — not some random number of points away, and not just wherever feels comfortable. A take profit is a planned exit, not something you decide in the moment based on fear or greed.
teach.dayliNote: Your stop loss protects your account and your structure logic — it isn't punishment, and it isn't about ego.
